waveform: Median recorded extracellular waveform from existing QC cache, up to 512 spikes per unit; peak-variance channel shown at interpolated native probe depth. QC calibration preserved in microvolts.
ccg: Recorded spike times in BackImage DPI-valid continuous intervals, separated at trial boundaries. Reference spikes require a complete +/-151-ms valid window. 151 bins centered -150 through +150 ms, width 2 ms. Conditional partner rate = coincidence count / eligible reference spikes / bin width. Positive lag means partner AFTER the selected unit. Dashed baseline is partner mean rate over the same valid BackImage intervals. No smoothing, shift-predictor subtraction, or inference of synaptic connectivity. All available trials, descriptive rather than held-out.
